_model_provenance.how: Verified by a real call from this machine on 2026-08-09: AgentProvider(model='gemini/gemini-3.5-flash-lite').generate('ping') returned text (11 tokens).
_model_provenance.cost: Free. The API key belongs to a project with NO billing account, so a successful call can only have been served by the free tier - nothing is chargeable. The free-tier limits for this model (15 requests/min, 250000 input tokens/min) are enforced by AgentProvider's own rate_limit block in config/model_profiles/*.json.
_model_provenance.note: Never edit from memory - confirm by docs or a real call (CLAUDE.md section 9).

planner._why: Splits indexes into mini-tasks for every later stage; a weak plan starves the whole pipeline. Weak/algorithmic today - rebuilt in Step 1.5.

doc_analyzer._why: Easiest stage: one pre-read documentation section in, one label plus one sentence out.

code_facts_analyzer._why: Reads real source and must stay literal about symbols, calls and effects.

behavior_analyzer._why: Synthesis across documentation plus code facts; the first stage that reasons rather than extracts.

spec_synthesizer._why: Final crossing artifact. Carries the clean-room burden (CLAUDE.md section 2), so it gets the strongest model.

plan_judge._why: Grades plans it did not write, dirty-side against the original. Same model as the planner by decision: Flash-Lite's ~500/day free tier is what makes a multi-round loop affordable at all. Accepted cost is shared blind spots, mitigated by a critique-first prompt. Swapping it to a stronger model is one line here.

border_gate._why: Adjudicates soft Border findings (DESCRIPTIVE/UNCERTAIN). Hard leaks never reach the model. Prefer a careful dismiss-or-fail judgement over throughput.
